title: git kura seal test — envelope data
description: Command-specific schema for the data payload of `git kura seal test --json <path...>`, nested under the common envelope's data field.

currentKey.description: The key derived from the current managed worktree.

passed.description: True when no path is claimed by a different key. False when at least one path has status claimed-by-other-key.

results.description: Per-path inspection results, in the same order as the input paths.

status.description: Stable status token for this path.

safe.description: True when this path is safe to edit in the current seal context.

claimedBy.description: The key that claims this path, or null if unclaimed or missing.
